citations.title: October 2026 Product Updates | Reveal
excerpts: # New in Reveal, October 2026: Reveal AI, Claude and ChatGPT Collection in Onna, and More

ASK, aji, and Brainspace under one name, ChatGPT and Claude collection for every Onna customer, and Logikcull productions without the all-black pages: here’s what shipped in October across Reveal Enterprise, Logikcull, Onna, and Reveal Hold.
#### Three brands enter. Only one leaves: Meet Reveal AI.
In a rare display of restraint from the legal tech industry, we took three feature names and turned them into one.
Reveal AI brings ASK, aji, and Brainspace together under one name, and it picked up some new tricks this month:

* **Ask a Document\*:** Pose a question from the Document Viewer and get an answer about the document in front of you, based on each user’s assigned permissions. It stays in its lane, and its lane is the document you’re looking at.
* **Allocations:** Instance admins can see how many Reveal AI questions are asked across the instance and in each project.

* **Fuller indexing\*:** Reveal AI can now read a document’s full text, including email headers and boilerplate, up to the maximum supported document size. Yes, even the confidentiality disclaimer nobody else has read since 2009.
* **Citations in Canada:** Reveal AI answers in Canada now come with citations, using your existing index with no reindexing.
* **No more waiting on indexing:** Reveal AI keeps answering while new data is indexed, with a heads-up that results may shift once indexing finishes.
#### ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude Connectors now available to all customers
What happens in the chat window stays in the chat window. At least, it used to...

Onna’s ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude connectors are now available to every Onna customer. Both collect AI conversations through each vendor’s compliance API, so you can search, review, and export them alongside your other Onna sources.

basis.reasoning: Reveal’s October 2026 product-update release describes newly shipped Reveal AI and Onna connectors, within the six months before November 9, 2026.
